title: Rivet library
description: Creates a Rivet component library: source exports per subpath (tree-shakeable, sideEffects false), Vitest with rivetTest(), and a package build when publishable.

directory.description: Project folder, relative to the workspace root (e.g. libs/ui-kit).
directory.x-prompt: Which directory do you want to create the library in?

publishable.description: Add a build target (@rivetjs/nx:package) that emits .js / .jsx + .d.ts into dist/<directory>.

addPlugin.description: Use inferred targets (default: true unless NX_ADD_PLUGINS=false).

skipPackageJson.description: Do not add dependencies to the root package.json.

skipInstall.description: Do not run the package manager install.
